gameDissections.evidenceSummary: At t=1620..4230, 5 of 8 bots crashed on `TypeError: rnd is not a function` in `tryClaimNearTeamIslands`. At t=4230, `[HOT-IMPORT]` revived all 8 bots (squadL=121,611, squadB=11.22M, avgD=92.3, ryan_m d=107.5). Immediately, `oppFloorCap=38` + `totB=B+myOut` + `isPrimeLand keep<=10*L` caused `ryan_m` to dump 3.25M troops between t=4320..4500 (density crashed 107.5 -> 16.5 -> 14.6) and again at t=4950..5040 (13 commands in 90 ticks, density crashed 23.9 -> 7.1 while opening nb=1 -> 4 enemy fronts). Even as Team 4 held #1 (151,096 land vs Team 1 132,955 and Team 6 113,174 at t=5139), `kevin_k` (t=5280..5292, 7x 10%B pokes) and `ethan21` (t=5450..5460, 6x 10%B pokes) machine-gunned enemy #8 every 2 ticks due to missing cooldown in `tryDonateToTeammate`, hollowing the entire squad for Team 6's counter-sweep.

In a 6-team 61-human lobby (Map 22, 664,497 land), pre-`d590acd` `findVirtualSquadAnchor` failed to anchor on a single main continent: 4 of 8 bots (`ryan_m`, `ethan21`, `mark07`, `noah88`) fell into the fallback loop (`voronoiPixels=500`, `minAllyDist=609..653px`) scattered across opposite map corners. Isolated frontline bot `ryan_m` fired 183 commands by t=1530 (`d=2.5`, `nb=4`) and died at t=2356 with Team 2 holding only 84,451 land (12.7%) against Team 1's 204,109.

All 8 bots spawned in a tight cluster (`minSep=48..114px`) on Map 17 (292,727 land), boxing in 3 inner bots (`kevin_k`, `noah88`, `dave_w` with `nb=0`) while outer guards `leo_tx` (`d=4.4, nb=4`) and `mark07` (`d=4.6, nb=3`) over-expanded at t=1980. Furthermore, `ethan21`, `leo_tx`, `ryan_m`, and `noah88` triggered 32 unthrottled `[HL-ASSIST]` 10%B pokes (7 pokes in 12 ticks at t=2794..2806, 5 at t=3396..3404, 14 at t=4482..4550) against enemy #57 (`Russian Empire [OG]`), draining frontline balances while 3 boxed-in rear bots sat at `d=71.7..76.0` (below the `dMe >= 132` non-inland donation gate because they had coastline).

Classic #1 lead throw in a 3-team game: Team 1 held #1 at t=5422 with 248,433 land (45.5% of map vs Team 2's 226,797 and Team 3's collapsing 66,931). Between t=1920..6640, `noah88` and `kevin_k` launched 61 `[HL-INTERCEPT]` chase boats (burning 90 total boats and >1.8M troops/tax, often double-chasing the exact same `boatId` on the same tick). Worse, `leo_tx` (27,199 land, boxed-in coastal rear with `nb=0` from t=2520 to t=6570) was bled every 18 ticks down to `d=70~76` by `tryDonateToTeammate` instead of compounding to `140*L`. At t=6570..6660, `noah88` (`20,018L`) and `lucas94` (`18,092L`) over-pulsed collapsing Team 3 remnants (`noah88` fired 18 commands in 90 ticks, crashing density `96.9 -> 33.8`; `lucas94` dropped `32.0 -> 27.8` with `nb=3`, plus `noah88` fired 14 unthrottled 10%B `[HL-ASSIST]` pokes at t=6594..6622). Team 2 counter-attacked their `d=27.8~33.8` frontline at t=6660 and swept `lucas94` (t=6988), `leo_tx` (t=7237), and `noah88` (t=7404).

In a 6-team 55-human match on Map 22 (664,497 land), 4 of 8 bots (`ryan_m`, `leo_tx`, `ethan21`, `noah88`) hit the `voronoi=500` scattered fallback (`minAllyDist=573..594px`). Squad land at t=1530 was only 51,425 (7.7% of map), and by t=2417 Team 2 held just 35,169 land (5.3%, 6th of 6 teams) before being eliminated by t=3890.

All 8 bots spawned cohesively on Map 24 (`762,763` land, `voronoi=10,199..24,956`, `minSep=112px`), reaching `160,523` squad land (21.0% of map, `8.83M` troops) at t=4230..4320. However, 5 bots (`ryan_m`, `leo_tx`, `lucas94`, `mark07`, `dave_w`, holding 74,240 land = 46% of squad territory) were 100% boxed-in (`nb=0`), leaving ONLY `ethan21` (`47,231L`) and `noah88` (`9,273L`) on the frontline. Because the 5 rear bots had coastline (`hasExposedCoast=true`), `tryDonateToTeammate` treated them as `isPureInlandSafe=false` (`dMe >= 132` required for general surplus donate, or `dMe >= 106` only when an ally had `inHumanAtk >= 12%B`), so all 5 rear bots sat frozen at `d=70.8~77.7` while `ethan21` fought alone at `d=14.3~23.1` (`oppFloorCap=38` + `totB=B+myOut` + `keep<=10*L`). Simultaneously, `kevin_k` and `noah88` fired 63 `[HL-INTERCEPT]` boats (102 total boats), draining coastal balances. When Team 4 (377k->526k land) breached `ryan_m` at t=4410..4611, our 5 medium-density rear bots were eaten one by one in a domino cascade (`t=4611, 4935, 5219, 5383, 5464`).

Positive control (sole win, 2-team 59-human match on Map 10, 546,152 land): because `teamCount=2`, our Team 2 had ~29 players (8 `[Nope]` bots + ~21 human allies = 50% of lobby). Even when our frontline bot `ryan_m` over-expanded at `d=1.1~5.8` and died at t=3157 (`noah88` also disconnected `1006` at t=3437), Team 2 already held 304,624 land (55.8%) vs Team 1's 237,551. Surviving bots `lucas94` (17,077L, boxed-in `nb=0` compounding to `d=121.2`), `mark07` (6,977L), and `kevin_k` (1,412L) donated 24 times to frontline allies as Team 2 swept Team 1 to 545,700 land (99.9%) at t=5405.

Only 7 of 8 bots entered (`noah88` missed room entry due to `headlessInRoom0 >= 7` ready gate + proxy jitter). All 7 bots spawned on the north continent of Map 13 (`430,654` land) and reached `85,548` squad land (19.9% of map, #1 contender in a 6-team game) at t=2070, compounding to `6.07M` squad troops (`avgD=83.7`) at t=3510. At t=3510..3912, `ethan21` dropped to `d=10.7` (`oppFloorCap=38` + `totB`) and `kevin_k`, `lucas94`, `mark07`, `ryan_m` fired 41 unthrottled 10%B `[HL-ASSIST]` pokes across 3 different enemies (`#2 SGX union`, `#18 Turk`, `#41 rubi`), provoking a multi-team coalition from Team 2 and Team 5 that collapsed `kevin_k` (t=4392), `mark07` (t=4630), `dave_w` (t=4638), `ethan21` (t=4942), and `ryan_m` (t=5425).

Severe V12 lobby/network degradation: only 6 of 8 bots entered (`dave_w` and `noah88` missed entry due to `minStartsIn <= 14 && headlessInRoom0 >= 5` loose gate + proxy socket churn, with 19,956 `socket close` events logged during G09), AND the 6 bots were split by the game server across two opposing teams: Team 2 (`kevin_k`, `mark07`, `lucas94`, `leo_tx`) and Team 3 (`ethan21`, `ryan_m`)! Because `spawn-coordinator.mjs` placed all 6 bots in the exact same northern basin (`y=20..130`), our Team 2 and Team 3 bots fought each other in the opening (`kevin_k d=0.7`, `mark07 d=4.2`, both dying at t=2012..2085; `ethan21` and `ryan_m` dying at t=3609..3827; `leo_tx` disconnecting at t=6685), leaving `lucas94` stranded on an island until t=14666.

variableEvaluations.currentValue: No #1 lead-protection lock; oppFloorCap=38; collapseFloorCap=16; totB=B+myOut; isPrimeLand keep<=10*L..26*L; [HL-ASSIST] 10%B poke has 0 cooldown (fires every 2 ticks); boxed-in coastal rear bots locked at d=70~78 without feeding frontline.
variableEvaluations.baseline80PctValue: oppFloorCap=128; collapseFloorCap=85; avail=B-fee-keep (home B only); period=5 (280ms); Boss npl acted as centralized high-density frontline anchor receiving steady 5% surplus donations.
variableEvaluations.recommendedOptimalValue: Three Iron Laws of Lead Closing when L_team >= 0.22*L_map or Team Rank == 1: (1) Frontline Home Density Lock: keep_home >= max(68*L, 0.78*safeAt), strictly using B_home (never totB=B+myOut) when humanNbCount >= 1; (2) Rear-to-Frontline Conveyor: any bot with enemyHumanNbs.length === 0 && neutral === 0 (even with coast, if boatN_threat === 0) donates 8%B every 24t above dMe >= 45 directly to the largest/lowest-density frontline brother (nb >= 1); (3) Assist Cooldown & Single-Team Focus Lock: add 60-tick per-bot cooldown on [HL-ASSIST] (`this.lastAssistTick`) + `isBeingAssisted` check, and penalize attacking non-focus enemy teams by 1.35x when leading.
variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: Across both the overnight Team batch (3/8 non-2-team games reached #1 or >140k squad land: G01 151k, G04 248k, G06 160.5k, yet 0/3 converted to a win = 100% throw rate) and the 100-game fdvg v33/v32 live corpus (28 games reached >=100k peak land, 23/28 = 82.1% threw; 16 games reached 150k..200k+ contested #1, 15/16 = 93.8% threw), every midgame throw follows a 3-stage cascade at t=4200..6660: Stage 1 (Frontline Self-Hollowing): `totB = B + myOut` + `oppFloorCap = 38` + `isPrimeLand keep <= 10*L` causes our leading frontline bot (`ryan_m` in G01, `noah88/lucas94` in G04, `ethan21` in G06) to chain-pulse collapsing enemies until actual home density `B_home/L` drops to `7.1 ~ 27.8`. Stage 2 (Rear Hoarding & Assist Bleed): 46%~62% of squad territory is held by boxed-in rear teammates (`nb=0`) sitting on coastlines at `d=70~78` that refuse to donate to the frontline (`!isPureInlandSafe` requires `dMe >= 132`), OR bordering teammates fire unthrottled 10%B `[HL-ASSIST]` pokes every 2 ticks (6~14 pokes in 12~28 ticks!) because `g.hasAttack(me, q)` is still false during the 2~4 tick WebSocket RTT window. Stage 3 (Perimeter Rupture): adjacent enemy mainstays (`d=105~130`) counter-punch the `d < 28` frontline bot, breaking into our low-density rear cluster and wiping 5~6 bots within 600 ticks.

variableEvaluations.recommendedOptimalValue: Require >= 7/8 (ideally 8/8) bots verified in Room 0 (`headlessInRoom0 >= 7`, remove `headlessInRoom0 >= 5 && minStartsIn <= 14` loose entry that caused G08 7-bot and G09 6-bot entries); in `chooseSpawn` & `isTeammate`, dynamically group by `g.teams[me]` so if server splits squad across 2 teams, minority-team bots do not cluster inside majority-team bots' basin; add socket-1 reconnect backoff to stop 19,956 close loops.
variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: In Team mode with `H` total players (`H ≈ 48..61`) divided into `K_teams` teams, a team's average size is `H / K_teams`. With `N_my` active bots on the same team, our controlled share of our own team is `N_my / (H / K_teams) = (N_my * K_teams) / H`, while our team's baseline prior win probability is `1 / K_teams` (50.0% in 2-team, 33.3% in 3-team, 25.0% in 4-team, 20.0% in 5-team, 16.7% in 6-team). Last night's 9 games had a harsh lobby distribution: FOUR 6-team games (G01, G02, G05, G08), TWO 5-team games (G06, G09), ONE 4-team game (G03), ONE 3-team game (G04), and only ONE 2-team game (G07, which we won). Even more critically, effective bot count `N_eff` (bots alive on the same team without JS crash or mid-game 1006 disconnect) was < 8 in 6 of 10 matches: G00 (8 bots crashed at t=420 on `rnd is not a function`), G01 (5 bots crashed from t=1620 to t=4230), G04 (`ryan_m` crushed to 3px at t=1530), G07 (`noah88` disconnected `left` at t=3437), G08 (only 7 bots entered), and G09 (only 6 bots entered, split 4 vs 2 across Team 2 and Team 3, plus `leo_tx` disconnected at t=6685). When `N_eff = 8` on the same continent (G01 post-hot-import, G06), our squad achieved 136.8k~160.5k land (#1/#2 on map) even in 5~6 team lobbies; when `N_eff <= 6` or scattered (G00, G02, G05, G09), midgame land share collapsed to < 8%.
